build_speaker_classifier_teacher: build a SpeakerClassifierTeacher to train an RPA classifier on dialogue episodes with speaker labels
create_rpa_episodes: create RPA episodes from LIGHT dialogue data by enumerating all possible start and label positions
run_who_is_speaking_teacher: run the WhoIsSpeakingTeacher to classify which character is speaking in a dialogue turn
test_am_i_me_or_you_teacher: test the AmIMeOrYouTeacher to classify whether an utterance belongs to self or partner
review_response_classifier_teacher: review the ResponseClassifierTeacher to evaluate model responses against an RPA predictor classifier
